main.description: Jeff's current status on skiddle.id: the status badge and the home page. One record, key 'self'.

available.description: Open to new work: true only when state is 'available'. Kept for readers that don't know state.

state.description: What kind of status: 'available' (open to new work, green), 'busy' (amber), 'dnd' (do not disturb, red) or 'away' (grey). Readers that don't know the value go by 'available'.

text.description: What the status says, e.g. 'open to consulting'.

emoji.description: One emoji shown instead of the coloured dot, e.g. '✈️'. Without one, the dot shows the state's colour.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the local time, e.g. 'Asia/Bangkok'.
